roles.title: Senior Product Manager, Payments and Cards

bullets: Own the development, user experience, management, and growth of the Cloaked Pay suite
Define and implement internal operations and processes required to efficiently run Cloaked Pay
Create and execute a concrete GTM strategy for a successful Cloaked Pay large rollout
Collect and analyze product data to continuously grow and adapt the product based off of consumer insights
Work closely with departments like Engineering, Marketing, Customer Service, and Regulatory Affairs to achieve broader company goals
Find the problems yourself: talk to members, dig into reports, chat transcripts, and data to see where the AI falls short
Own each outcome to the finish: prove it's fixed and leave monitors so we know if it breaks. Don't stop at filing a ticket
Lead engineers and designers through the work and clear their blockers
Own how Cloaked's AI acts for members: what they can ask it to do, the work it takes on, how it feels to use, and how members see what was done, with proof, so they trust it with…
Build evaluations that ensure the quality, safety, and consistency of what our systems do for members
